name: Speak with Un'thuwa
label: Quest
description: Speak with Un'thuwa: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Un'thuwa, tribal mage of Sen'jin Village, detects a disturbance in the magic currents of Durotar and asks for aid. Speak with Un'thuwa and do what you can to help him.
Do this, and in time further secrets will be revealed to you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hail, friend. Praise to you, for my call for aid is now answered. Let us hope you are up to the task...
